phase_name: The Command and the Direct-Execution Skill

objectives.description: Resolve the tracked Rule E gap: add external_scripts manifest field to check-extension-docs.sh
Verify structural properties and doc-lint clean for approvals

deviations.description: Scope addition: check-extension-docs.sh (core) was not in the plan's Files to modify list for any phase
deviations.reason: Resolving the Rule E gap tracked since Phase 1 required a small, additive fix to a core script, since approve.sh/check-approvals.sh are external consumer-repo scripts that can never be declared in any provides.scripts here. Added a narrowly-scoped manifest-level `external_scripts` array field, read by check_referenced_scripts_declared as one more exclusion set, parallel to its existing core_declared/all_declared_scripts/own_hooks sets. Verified: check-extension-docs.sh now reports [approvals] OK (no FAIL); full-repo run shows only the expected, deploy-pending drift FAIL for the edited core script itself (resolves at Phase 9's deploy step), with no new FAIL introduced for any other of the 22 other extensions.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added external_scripts field to check-extension-docs.sh, outside the plan's declared Files to modify, to resolve the Rule E gap tracked since Phase 1; verified no regression across all other extensions)*

deviations.description: Phase 7's 'dry-run walk-through against a fixture review file' verification bullet
deviations.reason: Per the plan's own Risk table ('/approve is authored in this repository but exercised only in a consumer repository, so no end-to-end run is available here... the dry-run path is the live check the owner runs in the consumer repository'), a literal live AskUserQuestion dry run cannot be performed by a dispatched, non-interactive agent in this repository. Verification instead reused the Phase 5 hand-run fixtures (identical/decl-added/comment-only/malformed) to confirm the classify-to-summary mechanical chain (Stages 4-5) produces sane, well-formed output, and hand-traced the Stage 7 --record command format. No component with a real approve.sh exists in THIS repository to run Stage 3 against, and running one against the actual ~/Projects/Logos/Verification consumer repo was out of scope and not attempted (would mutate an unrelated repository's state without being asked).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — dry-run verification performed via the Phase 5 fixture chain and a hand-traced --record command, not a live AskUserQuestion session, per the plan's own stated inherent limit)*
